description_preview:
About Qbeast
We're redefining how the world works with big data.
At Qbeast, we believe in transforming the way the tech world processes and analyzes data. Data has become the lifeblood of modern activities, and its importance grows daily with the rise of cutting-edge AI workloads. The demand for efficient, cost-effective, and scalable data solutions has never been higher.
Just like the Cubism Art Movement changed the way to perceive reality in the early 20th century, we at Qbeast crave for radically different approaches to storing and processing data. Qbeast is an early-stage startup on a mission to accelerate data analytics for Data Lakehouses—independent of query engine or table format. Born from research at the Barcelona Supercomputing Center (BSC), Qbeast’s foundation lies in groundbreaking multi-dimensional indexing techniques.
We envision a future in which this core indexing technology initially becomes an essential piece of data infrastructure and over time expands to touch every critical aspect of data engineering, from storage all the way to query engines, redefining how we approach current and future AI workloads. Our goal is to make this technology accessible worldwide, across clouds, and reshape the landscape of data processing.
With headquarters in Barcelona and Seattle, we are a diverse, international team driven by passion and expertise. Backed by strong funding, we have the resources and time to craft a product that delights our customers. We value flexibility, offering a hybrid remote work model and adaptable working hours.
Job Details
‍
The Opportunity
We are looking for a talented engineer to join our team and contribute to the development of our core acceleration technology. This role involves enhancing our core multi-dimensional indexing implementation for Data Lakehouses. You’ll collaborate closely with the team to introduce groundbreaking features that are unique in the market.
‍
As a core member of our tech team, you will:
Develop and enhance our indexing technology using Java, Scala, and Rust.
Build support for open table formats such as Iceberg.
Maintain and improve product quality by resolving defects and creating robust test cases and frameworks.
Explore other areas of interest—in a startup, there’s always more to do and learn.
‍
What We Are Looking For:
Experience: A minimum of three years in professional software development.
Education: A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
Technical Skills:
Strong knowledge of algorithms and data structures.
Familiarity with database internals.
Experience with Data Lakehouse formats (e.g., Delta Lake, Apache Hudi, Apache Iceberg) is a plus.
Knowledge of storage I/O is a bonus.
Proficiency in Java, Scala, and Rust, with the adaptability to work in other languages as needed.
Experience with query engines like Apache Spark, Trino, or emerging ones like DataFusion.
Soft Skills:
Proficiency in English (our working language).
Organized, autonomous, and proactive approach to work.
Willingness to learn new skills and share knowledge.
A collaborative mindset and strong team spirit.
‍
Our Tech Stack
Revolutionary data analytics technology supporting various processing frameworks.
Cloud-based infrastructure spanning multiple providers.
Kubernetes for orchestration, Terraform for infrastructure management, and GitHub for version control.
A SaaS platform powered by Typescript, Rust, Java, Scala, and Python.
‍
What We Offer
A Startup Culture: Be part of building both revolutionary software and a forward-thinking work environment.
A Talented Team: Collaborate with a high concentration of tech talent.
Impact: Shape the future of Qbeast, a company poised to become a reference in Data Engineering.
Growth Opportunities: Constant learning in both technology and business.
If our mission excites you and you’re ready to make a difference in data infrastructure, we’d love to hear from you.
Join Qbeast and help us redefine the future of data!

A Little Bit About Us
:You might know us from our founder and CEO, Dave Ramsey, who’s given no-nonsense money advice on the radio since 1992. Three decades later, Ramsey Solutions is a household name in personal finance, with a mission to change the toxic money culture for good.
Our Mission:
Ramsey Solutions provides biblically based, commonsense education and empowerment that give HOPE to everyone in every walk of life.
Here’s a Taste Of Our Benefits
Health insurance (includes plans eligible for an HSA—with a company match up to $500!)
401(k) retirement plan with 4% match/company contribution
Annual wellness, counseling and grocery membership reimbursement
On-campus cafe with subsidized pricing for breakfast, lunch and coffee bar
Dependent care FSA
Tons of cultural activities, like weekly devotional, leadership development courses, Battle of the Bands, and one epic Christmas party!
Where And How You’d Work
Ramsey Solutions Headquarters is located just outside of Nashville in Franklin, Tennessee. We value our strong, unified company culture because we believe the best work is done together. That’s why all of our team members work on-site under the same roof. But work-life balance is also important to us, so we offer flexible work schedules to take the stress out of appointments, family obligations and other needs that may pop up.
While every team member has a designated workspace (with an electronic sit-stand desk), our campus was designed to house a variety of unique work and play zones (e.g., quiet library space, coffee bar/lounge areas, recreational game zone, and outside/patio work and break areas).
What You’d Do In This Role
The Analytics Engineer produces consumable data products, including analytical data models and curated tables, metrics, and visualizations that enable others to explore trends, ask questions, and apply data in decision-making. The Analytics Engineer focuses on enabling reasoning by others through well-designed warehouse models and clear visual representations of data.
You’re Probably a Match If
You have 2+ years of experience as an analytics engineer, data analyst, or another similar role.
You have the ability to clearly communicate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
You are proficient in SQL and scripting languages (for example: Python and R)
You have experience with several of the following:
Data pipelining and ETL/ELT processes
Data modeling and dimensional modeling
Data visualization (e.g. Streamlit, Plotly, Shiny)

Build and maintain data warehouses and data marts, ensuring high standards of data quality, accuracy, and consistency across the platform.
Design, develop, and optimize scalable data pipelines and ETL processes using modern tools (e.g., SQL, Python, Apache Airflow, dbt, Snowflake, AWS Redshift), including monitoring for performance and data integrity.
Establish and enforce robust data quality checks and monitoring systems to proactively identify and resolve data issues.
Develop and maintain source-of-truth reports and dashboards for key business metrics, ensuring consistency across all reporting channels.
Build deep expertise in key datasets and data models to support reliable, well-informed analytics.
Partner with customers and stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into actionable data products.
Serve as a trusted advisor to analytics customers and stakeholders on data-related strategy and best practices.

About Lochner
Founded in 1944, Lochner is a trusted infrastructure services provider for aviation, surface transportation and water clients who need high-quality, forward-looking solutions to complex challenges. Our vision is to become a Top 100 leader in the A/E industry, centered on an agile, engaged, and empowered workforce coming together to embrace the art of the possible and make a lasting difference in our world.
Are you ready to join us on this journey?
As a people-centric company, Lochner's purpose is to empower our team to put their knowledge to work, enhancing communities across the US. To achieve this, we hire candidates of all experiences and skillsets because amazing things happen when people with diverse backgrounds come together to solve problems. We believe collaboration is more than a buzz word — it is a guiding principle in which every point of view is valued and heard and is the driving force in delivering our best work. At all levels of the organization, we foster an entrepreneurial spirit and culture of autonomy to advance our strategic vision and continually seek our next success story. Lochner – learn more about us
Traffic Engineer/Transportation Planner (Entry Level)
Overview
The Junior Traffic Engineer / Transportation Planner will support a variety of traffic engineering, planning, and applied technology projects under the direct supervision of senior staff. This entry-level position is designed for fresh graduates who bring a strong academic foundation, sharp analytical skills, and a genuine interest in leveraging data and emerging technologies to solve real-world transportation challenges. This role offers hands-on exposure to FDOT project delivery, traffic operations, systems planning, and innovative decision-support tools, providing an excellent foundation for a career in consulting
Key Responsibilities
Traffic Engineering & Operations
Assist in traffic data collection, reduction, and analysis (vehicle counts, speed studies, turning movement counts, pedestrian and bicycle counts).
Support traffic impact studies, corridor studies, and intersection analyses using industry-standard software (Synchro, SimTraffic, HCS, VISSIM).
Prepare fundamental traffic signal warrant analyses, sight distance evaluations, and capacity/level-of-service assessments.
Contribute data and sections to the development of Traffic Engineering Studies and Traffic Operations reports for FDOT and local agency clients.
Transportation Planning & Systems Analysis
Support travel demand modeling efforts by assisting with model validation inputs, data assembly, and routine scenario analysis.
Assist in subarea studies, corridor planning, and Systems Planning tasks including SIS and freight analyses.
Help prepare draft technical memoranda, planning reports, and presentations for agency stakeholders and public involvement processes.
Project Support & Deliverables
Prepare high-quality technical figures, tables, charts, and report sections.
Coordinate closely with project managers and senior engineers to meet deadlines and learn company standards.
Participate in site visits, field data collection activities, and client meetings as a developmental opportunity.
Maintain organized project files and documentation consistent with firm QA/QC standards.
Who Are You
Education and Experience
Experience: Entry-level (0–3 years of experience). Prior internship or co-op experience at a transportation engineering/planning firm or a public transportation agency (FDOT, MPO, municipality) is a significant plus.
Master of Science (MS) in Civil Engineering (with a Transportation focus), Transportation Engineering, or Transportation Planning is highly preferred for fresh graduates.
Bachelor of Science (BS) in Civil Engineering or a related discipline with relevant project/coursework.
Skills: Exposure to traffic analysis and/or modeling tools beyond standard classroom theory is an asset.
Professional Attributes
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to convey technical concepts clearly.
Self-motivated with the ability to manage tasks efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
Collaborative team player who enjoys working across disciplines and seniority levels.
Intellectual curiosity and an eagerness to learn new tools, methods, and technologies.

description_preview:
Overview:
At Capital One, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world-class talent — along with our deep experience in machine learning — position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to continuing to build world-class applied science and engineering teams to deliver our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build.
Team Description:
The Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. We work hand-in-hand with our partners across the company to advance the state of the art in science and AI engineering, and we build and deploy proprietary solutions that are central to our business and deliver value to millions of customers. Our AI models and platforms empower teams across Capital One to enhance their products with the transformative power of AI, in responsible and scalable ways for the highest leverage impact.
In this role, you will:
Partner with a cross-functional team of engineers, research scientists, technical program managers, and product managers to deliver AI-powered products that change how our associates work and how our customers interact with Capital One.
Design, develop, test, deploy, and support AI software components including foundation model training, large language model inference, similarity search, guardrails, model evaluation, experimentation, governance, and observability, etc.
